$comment: Labelled replies for the offer claim the Bookkeeper's bare hand-off scenarios judge. The claim is for replies to a sender's request: a live judge was unreliable on long month-end reports, so those are not judged with it and are not cases here. Run a live judge over it with: officehum judge-check packages/sdk/src/fixtures/judged-offer-replies.json --judge provider/model
claim: The reply says the assistant itself will, or offers to, pass, flag or forward the request to someone, now or later. Saying nothing has been passed on, or telling the sender to contact the person themselves, does not count.
